capabilities: DiD, synthetic controls, RD, interrupted series and IV
limitation: Posterior uncertainty is conditional on design and model assumptions
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: A named quasi-experimental design, formula, timing/threshold variables and chosen Bayesian or OLS model.
scientific_qualification.output: Design-specific contrast and posterior/OLS summaries; e.g. a local discontinuity at a supplied threshold.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Design-specific continuity, parallel-trend, donor or IV restrictions; prior and likelihood assumptions for Bayesian summaries.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Treat RD, DiD, synthetic control and IV as separate operations. Pin sampler/runtime configuration; the inspected README warns optional nutpie changes sampling defaults. Do not infer unconditional frequentist coverage from an HDI.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: For a specified RD, recover the population jump under continuity and expose manipulation/discontinuity confounding; replay with an explicit sampler selection and check numerical diagnostics.

evidence.finding: Quasi-experimental methods, Bayesian/OLS outputs, runtime notes and RD example.
